name: house-standard
purpose: The one starting point for every repository in the estate: a dark design kit (a living crystal hero, receipt cards, a stack, a glass that runs on the visitor's device, an honest expander) and a ship gate that holds any built page to seven rules, so a page leads with numbers it can prove and keeps its limits one click away.

lane.accepts: a built web page, as its HTML
lane.refuses: anything that is not a page: there is nothing to hold to the standard

interface.out: verified when the page meets all seven rules of the house standard; unverified when it fails any; refused when what is given is not a page

judge.what: a page ships only when it has the kit, greets no one with a wall of text, sources every receipt, leaves nothing unfinished, shows its failures, wears the house identity and keeps the house rules
